_readme: Curated legal-name to brand aliases for organization-to-endpoint resolution.
String matching gets a long way and then stops dead. The directory records
legal entities and the EHR vendors publish brands, and for the largest
health systems the two share no tokens at all: 'UNIVERSITY OF PITTSBURGH
PHYSICIANS' is UPMC's physician group and the strings have nothing in
common. No normalization rule recovers that, and every attempt to loosen
one produced a false merge instead (see the Penn Medicine / Penn State
Health case in h53_org_endpoint_resolution.py).
So the remaining links are curated rather than inferred. Each entry names
one publicly verifiable corporate fact and carries the source that states
it. That is auditable in a way a similarity threshold is not: a reader can
disagree with a specific row and check it, and a wrong row is a wrong
claim about one organization rather than a silent systematic error.
Rules for adding an entry:
- `ndh_name` must be the exact normalized NDH organization name.
- `brand` must match an organization name a vendor actually publishes.
- `basis` must be checkable by a reader without insider knowledge.
- If the relationship is uncertain, leave it out. Coverage is not worth
a wrong endpoint: sending a patient's app to the wrong health system
is a worse outcome than telling them we do not know.
Aliased links are reported as their own tier and never counted as
deterministic.

aliases.basis: University of Pittsburgh Physicians is UPMC's employed physician group; UPMC publishes it as part of the UPMC system on upmc.com and it shares UPMC's Epic tenancy.
Named UPMC in its own legal business name.
The University of Pennsylvania Health System trades as Penn Medicine.

aliases.ndh_name: CLINICAL PRACTICES OF THE UNIVERSITY OF PENNSYLVANIA
aliases.basis: Clinical Practices of the University of Pennsylvania is the faculty practice plan of Penn Medicine.
Lancaster General Health joined the University of Pennsylvania Health System in 2015 and trades as Penn Medicine Lancaster General Health.
Allegheny Clinic is the employed physician organization of Allegheny Health Network.
Jefferson University Physicians is the faculty practice of Thomas Jefferson University, which operates Jefferson Health.
Temple Faculty Practice Plan is the physician organization of Temple University Health System, which trades as Temple Health.
Temple Physicians Inc is a subsidiary of Temple University Health System.

aliases.ndh_name: THE MILTON S HERSHEY MEDICAL CENTER PHYSICIANS
aliases.basis: Penn State Milton S. Hershey Medical Center is the academic medical centre of Penn State Health.

aliases.ndh_name: PENN STATE HEALTH MEDICAL GROUP LLC
aliases.basis: Named Penn State Health in its own legal business name. Recorded explicitly because a token rule wrongly matched this to Penn Medicine, a different system.
PinnacleHealth was acquired by UPMC in 2017 and operates as UPMC in Central Pa.
Bradford Regional and Elk Regional joined UPMC as UPMC Cole and UPMC Bradford.
